notes.title: Summary of Patches
notes.content:
Hello all! Thank you for being the first folks over the top and into the world of Isaiah 188. I won't waste your time, let's see what's important for you to note:
[list]
[*] A new font! Everyone, my wife included, has said the non-dialogue font sucks, so I have replaced it. There may be some string alignment issues, but I checked as many as I could and they seemed fine. If you find one that's wrong holler at me and I'll go shift it. If this font sucks too, the hunt shall continue!
[*] If you have a non-supported (as in, not 1920x1080 or 3840x2160) screen size, I'm pretty sure textboxes always spawn too far down and too far to the right for you, so now if you press Q, they will move UPWARDS, and if you press R they will move TO THE LEFT. If your textboxes are in some other weird direction, or perhaps they are non-euclidean, let me know and I'll see what I can do for you, but it will probably wait for the next patch. Why R and Q? No clue! I'll add formal buttons for this... at some point.
[*]  A bunch of bug fixes. Any crash or unbeatable campaign mission that was noted on the forum up to this point [i]should[/i] be fixed. If not, please let me know. I would like to personally thank [b]fleetgothic[/b] for toughing it out and giving me some good bug reports. 
[/list]

notes.title: Game is in release queue!
notes.content:
Hello!

I must open with an apology: I forgot about the build review process, so I submitted my game today thinking it would get out, well, today, but nope, there's a few days of build review by steam left. I guess that means the game will be eligible for rewards and such in 2023 ([i]lol as if[/i]).

Anyway, the game is releasing with the UN ground and space campaigns, and a trio of solar conquest setups. The roadmap from here is as follows:

[list]
[*]Bug fixes and feature improvements
[*]Mars campaign
[*]Haptha campaign
[*]Bonus missions
[/list]

Not a long list, but I rather like games that I can look forward to additional content releases from as opposed to just bug updates, so this was something of a conscious decision on my part.

Anyway, I'd like to thank my awesome music guy, Pietro Frigerio, for his excellent soundtrack. You can blame me for the sound effects, art, and everything else about the game. 

I may do another news post when the game is actually out, but for now, we'll see what happens. I may have accidentally screwed up the possibility of releasing into early access, steamworks isn't the most user friendly thing ever, but rest assured: I'll be here fixing bugs and putting out content updates. 

Anyway, thanks for reading, and have a great start to 2023!
